demo_banner: DEMO MODE · Synthetic records · Human approval required · No automatic clinical release.
live_banner: Human approval required. Source observations, forecasts and proposed outcomes are shown separately.
empty: No observations available for this selection.
chart_error: Unable to load this chart. Try refreshing the data.
request_error: Data could not be loaded. Check your connection or sign in again.
limited: Read access to these charts is limited to authorized network roles.
note.forecast: Stock is a current observation; the seven-day AutoML estimate is a forecast, not confirmed demand. Missing AutoML estimates remain empty; baseline estimates are not relabelled as AutoML.
note.blood_types: Confirmed observations by blood type at the selected centers. Types are not interchangeable. Missing sources are excluded and identified; no missing stock is replaced with zero.
note.expiry: Current transferable units at reachable sources, grouped by declared expiry. This is exposure to expiry, not avoided waste or units already allocated to a transfer.
note.missing: Blank cells mean unavailable data, never zero stock. Inventory remains at each source institution.
note.hypothetical: Conditional FEFO simulation using source-declared lead time and expiry. Proposed receipts are not confirmed stock. A missing after-value means the proposed quantity cannot be validated against current source availability. Delivered transfers are excluded.
note.timeline: Recorded creation and transition events only. Missing milestones are not inferred. The selected period applies to event timestamps.
note.funnel: One matched historical cohort. The first two stages count people; the remaining stages count RBC units. No cross-unit conversion percentage is implied.
note.outcomes: Recorded campaign outcomes within the selected period. Released and used units are distinct.
note.schedule: Planned collection and expected release dates, not confirmed stock. Window spans the selected number of days before and after the application clock.
note.validation: Chronological validation: seven-day observed consumption vs. IntegratedML predictions, summed across available validation rows for the selected blood centers per day. Censored labels are excluded. Retrospective evaluation, not historical forecast issuance.
note.decisions: Recorded decision enums and review states, including blocked decisions. Distribution does not measure clinical effectiveness.
note.trends: Counts per recorded day: decisions, blocked reviews and delivery transitions. Days with no observations are not interpolated.
note.coverage: Filters select the operational context. The network matrix shows all eight blood types; stock and expiry are current observations. Historical charts use the reporting period. Reads are bounded to 1,000 recent records per entity.
validation_number: Enter a number within the allowed range.
validation_invalid: Check the value in this field.
demo_clock_advanced: Demo clock advanced. Automatic expiry will check pending invitations.
review_once: One review after expiry or decline; a manager must authorize new planning.
legacy.Relógio sintético avançado. Expir: Demo clock advanced. Automatic expiry will check pending invitations.
legacy.Reavaliação única após expiração/: One review after expiry or decline; a manager must authorize new planning.
javascript_required: Enable JavaScript to view charts. Operational records and forms remain available below.
note.projection: FEFO simulation using an even daily allocation of the seven-day AutoML estimate. This is not a daily AutoML forecast. Stock expires by source-declared dates; proposed transfers and campaigns are not counted as confirmed receipts.
note.comparison: Transferable units by blood type and blood center. Source reserves, blocked and expired units are excluded. No cross-type substitution is inferred.
note.actions: Requests and expected campaign releases are conditional. Institutional approval and confirmed receipt or release are required before stock changes.
no_pending_actions: No open transfer or campaign plans for this selection.
note.source_evidence: Current source observations for the selected blood type. Each institution retains ownership of its stock. A query does not reserve units.
campaign_planning_note: Each plan links a future need to a blood center, partner and feasible processing window. Approval creates invitations; acceptance does not create stock.
conditional_supply: Target and release dates are conditional planning values. Collected, released and used units remain separate.
next.PENDING_CENTER_APPROVAL: The responsible blood center manager must authorize or decline the plan.
next.AWAITING_PARTNER: The invited institution must accept before its invitation expires.
next.CONFIRMED: Await collection, processing and the responsible center’s release report.
next.PROPOSED: Review need, timing and supporting evidence.

similarity_note: Vector Search cosine similarity is contextual evidence, not a probability of success.
no_vector_evidence: No persisted similarity evidence for this record. Historical evidence is not invented.
